notes.title: 2.0 Release! End of early access.
notes.content:
[h1]Game Changes[/h1]
-Added a second world, built around a new power-up: recall
   -Pick up more recall power-ups to increase the time limit
   -Press space to recall instantly

-Added the ability to fast fall, tap down while at or below the apex of your jump to rapidly 
    descend to the floor
   -doing this will restore your sprint meter if it's in the red portion of the bar

-Improved hitboxes to not be total crap. Oh god, it was so bad before.

-Redone menu artwork and navigation

-Fixed a major performance issue where every level entered would decrease performance.

[h1]Levelbuilder changes.(Courtesy of Delta, aka adumbidiot)[/h1] 
-Improved startup time

-Fixed the darkness corrupting levels (was not as cool as it sounds)

-Various performance and UI improvements.

notes.title: Looking for beta testers!
notes.content:
Hi, I'm currently working on a whole host of new features that should make the game more enjoyable to play through fast, as well as new puzzle mechanics that I might use in future free content patches (Yay new levels!)

I need feedback on some mechanics I have in the works, and I'm hoping to get the (very small) "community" of this game involved as much as possible. 

If you own the game and are willing to use discord to give feedback, leave a comment on this announcement and I will send you an invite link along with an unreleased build of the game.
